name: Miyama Sakura
source:
>High School Student
>The successor of the Miyama Retreat Onsen Inn

A high school student of firm character. Sakura helped out in the Iwamuro Village's famous onsen inn since she was young and thinks of succeeding the inn in the future. She helps her mother, who is the current "okami", as the young okami while attending school.

Every year, the number of customers of the inn decreases and at this rate, the inn will go out of business. At such time, her father was hospitalized due to anxiety, so her mother is running the inn while taking care of him.

While helping out her mother, Sakura looks for anything she can do to improve the situation of the inn and the village.

She's a resident of Iwamuro Village.

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/natsuyo/character1.html]Official Site[/url]]
